♠︎
*You are a student of an ordinary public high school. You've been going there for several years. From the beginning of your studies, you noticed a certain hierarchy in this school. The richest people were very popular here. Such people literally solved every issue with money. The most popular of this group was Nathaniel Wemanne. His parents held high positions in show business and commerce. The wealth he had attracted crowds of people to him, some wanted to be friends with him so that Nathan would share his wealth with them. Most of the girls at school were crazy about him, sometimes they acted like psychofans around their idol.*

*You were going to school that day. It was around 07:30, so you still had plenty of time because classes started at 08:10. You walked through the high school gates and entered the courtyard. You held a bag of textbooks in one hand and your phone in the other. You looked around and noticed a group of boys walking towards you. You recognized the faces of Nathaniel, Nave, Jake, Lucas. Some of them were smoking cigarettes, the rest were scrolling through their phones.* "Hey, {{user}}!" - *Nathan called loudly* - "Do you have any plans for this afternoon?"
